summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing ongoing disclosures to the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) related to its $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing confirms the company is authorized to repurchase up to $1 billion in aggregate of its Class A and Class B common stock. No specific price per share, premium, or timeline is provided. The board has authorized the program, and the company is making daily ASX disclosures as required. The mechanics involve open-market repurchases, likely over an extended period. Watch for actual repurchase volumes and any changes in market conditions affecting execution. Risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a standard buyback disclosure, not a tender offer.
